svg.title: Ordered digits 1–9: solver not-found rates through 100,000
svg.desc: Bar chart for disjoint 10,000-number bands, followed by a cumulative not-found rate chart. Not found is not a proof of impossibility.
svg.text: Ordered digits 1–9: search outcomes up to 100,000
Every positive integer from 1 to 100,000 tested · exact rational arithmetic · local solver only
“Not found” means not found within this solver’s bounds — NOT proven impossible.
Local rate: disjoint bands of 10,000 consecutive integers
Each bar is the percentage not found in that band, not the cumulative percentage.
Cumulative rate: choose an integer uniformly from 1 through N
Fraction of the first N targets not found by this solver. Earlier easy numbers lower this average.
Limits: rational intermediates only; every reduced numerator and denominator is at most 2^63 − 1.
All digits 1–9 once in order; + − × ÷ ^, parentheses, adjacent-digit grouping and unary minus.
The cumulative line is plotted every 100 targets. CSVs retain all 100,000 outcomes and every found expression.
